notes.turn: turns to targetHeading (right or left by itself), slows down near it, stops within 2 deg.
notes.straight: forward at straightSpeed for straightTime (1/100 s), holding targetHeading.
notes.back: backward at straightSpeed for straightTime (1/100 s), holding targetHeading.
notes.across: forward at acrossSpeed until it has crossed acrossBlocks white blocks, holding targetHeading (counts the block it starts on). White = sensor below BL / BR, black again = above BL + 30 / BR + 30 (the same BL / BR as the line trace).
notes.lineTrace: your In-OutV4 line trace: finds the line first (spdSlow, up to 3 s), then follows it for traceCs (1/100 s), then stops.
